attchmntText: Pursuant to regulation 32(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and regulation 41(4) of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, please find enclosed the monitoring agency report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Care Ratings Limited, Monitoring Agency, appointed to monitor the utilization of proceeds of the public issue of the Company.

Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled "Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Ltd reports stellar H1 FY27 performance Revenue grew by 32.9% YoY and PAT grew by 59.7% YoY".

Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication in Financial Express and Jansatta on November 4, 2026, pertaining to the unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited consolidated and standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
